gaps: ProgramMaster exposes no "Data-Driven and Computational Materials Design" track/topic grouping — the conference page is a flat alphabetical symposia list; the candidate set here was keyword-filtered (comput|data|machine|artificial|informatic|algorithm|thermodynamic|hume|verification|multiscale) and then ranked by MLIP-relevant approved-presentation count. Official TMS topical track membership is [unverified].

Speaker/author AFFILIATIONS are not shown on ProgramMaster abstract pages (only names + planned on-site speaker). Institution matching therefore relied on PI/known-group-member surnames; a target-group student/postdoc presenting under an unrecognized name would be missed.

Only 4 symposia (201 approved abstracts) were crawled at abstract level. Title-only MLIP counts for un-crawled symposia: Modeling, AI Applications, and Method Development in Nuclear Materials = 7 MLIP-titled talks; Computational Thermodynamics and Kinetics = 2; Algorithms Development = 1; AI-ICME = 2; Mechanistic & Experimental Thermo/Kinetics = 1. Target-group presence in those symposia is [unverified].
Session scheduling (day/time/room) and final speaker confirmation are not yet published on ProgramMaster; "On-Site Speaker (Planned)" is provisional.

No hits for Csanyi/Cambridge, Kozinsky/Harvard, Isayev/CMU, Ceriotti/EPFL, or Ong/UCSD as authors/speakers in the crawled set — consistent with the landscape doc hypothesis that these groups favor ML/NeurIPS-adjacent venues, but absence in 4 symposia is not absence from TMS2027 (100+ symposia).
The landscape doc lists Marzari and Asta only as adjacent context; whether Lupine wants them treated as targets is a decision for the owner, not resolved here.

tms.org meeting pages (Default.aspx) returned no parseable text via curl in this sweep; dates/venue were verified from the ProgramMaster conference page instead (03/14/2027-03/18/2027, Orlando, FL, Orlando World Center Marriott).
